method: R1 blind suread (subagent read text only, no md/rules)

facts.fact: 离开 Dustin 与 Leah 家后，Hattie 与 Colm 一路沉默驱车前往火车站。
facts.anchor: They’re on their way to the train station, having ridden in silence until now.

facts.fact: Colm 说认识 Dustin 够久，能读懂他、知道何时该说话。
facts.anchor: But we’ve known each other long enough I can read him.

facts.fact: Colm 告诉 Hattie，Leah 高三时赢了比赛，诗作被收录进州级佳作选集。
facts.anchor: She won that contest our junior year, remember? Got her poem published in a state’s best compilation or something.

facts.fact: Hattie 向 Colm 道歉，说她和 Ed 从未真正问过他的童年。
facts.anchor: we never really asked you about your childhood.

facts.fact: Colm 说他母亲是瘾君子，生命最后阶段他很少和她在一起。
Colm 说母亲去世时他和姑姑在一起，没能见最后一面。
facts.anchor: I was with my aunt. I never got to say goodbye.

facts.fact: Colm 打转向灯急转进加油站，停车开始加油。
facts.anchor: He hits the turn signal and veers sharply into a gas station

facts.fact: Hattie 打开 GPS 历史行程页，唯一保存的路线是从 Colm 住处到 Dustin 与 Leah 家。
facts.anchor: The only saved trip is the route from Colm’s address to Dustin and Leah’s.

facts.fact: Hattie 输入 GPS 密码 1234 与 4321 均被拒；Colm 回车后她谎称想开音乐，随后响起 Black Keys 的 Everlasting Light。
facts.anchor: then taps in “1234” and hits “Enter.” The screen blinks negatively and the box empties. She tries “4321.”
